description: Defines classes and structures for managing F1AP procedures in a 3GPP network, including UE context management, paging, RRC context creation, and interface handling within the ocudu::ocucp namespace.

classes.name: f1ap_ue_context_release_command
classes.description: Represents a command to release a UE context in F1AP.

classes.name: f1ap_ue_context_manager
classes.description: Abstract class for managing UE context procedures such as setup, release, modification, and ID updates.

classes.name: f1ap_paging_manager
classes.description: Abstract class for handling F1AP paging procedures.

classes.name: ue_rrc_context_creation_request
classes.description: Request structure for creating an RRC context for a UE.

classes.name: ue_rrc_context_creation_response
classes.description: Response structure for RRC context creation request.

classes.name: ue_rrc_context_creation_outcome
classes.description: Expected outcome type for RRC context creation.

classes.name: f1ap_common_du_task_notifier
classes.description: Interface for scheduling F1AP async tasks.

classes.name: f1ap_du_processor_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the DU processor about F1AP events.

classes.name: f1ap_interface_management_handler
classes.description: Interface for managing F1AP interface procedures.

classes.name: f1ap_cu
classes.description: Main class combining all F1AP handling functionalities for the CU.
